observations.name: candidate_structures
limitations: Finite conformer search; not a global minimum claim.

observations.name: search_filter_program

value.algorithm: RDKit ETKDGv3 fixed seed 1701; force-field optimization; carbon-chain Kabsch RMSD duplicate check with reversed-order equivalence; 0.15 A threshold; greedy distinct selection; ORCA r2SCAN-3c single points.

limitations: Program is the executed Python code artifact; provenance JSON summarizes it.

observations.name: selected_conformers

value.selection_rule: force-field energy ascending, pairwise carbon-chain RMSD >= 0.15 A under identity/reversed mapping

limitations: Selected subset is from a finite search, not global minimization.

observations.name: energy
limitations: Only selected candidates were computed by ORCA; force-field energies are not ORCA energies.
Finite search; lowest is not global/free-energy minimum.

observations.name: conformer_duplicate_check

value.method: Kabsch RMSD on six carbon atoms; min(identity, reversed carbon-chain order)

observations.formula: RMSD = sqrt(mean_i ||R(P_i - mean(P)) - (Q_i - mean(Q))||^2), evaluated for Q and Q_reversed
limitations: Heavy-atom RMSD uses carbon atoms because n-hexane has only carbon heavy atoms.

observations.name: energy_ranking
limitations: Lowest in this finite search only; not global or free-energy minimum.

observations.name: search_provenance_report

value.search_scope: RDKit ETKDGv3 embedded 64 conformers from SMILES CCCCCC, all saved as candidates.
value.geometry_source: Initial geometry from managed structure.prepare seed.xyz; task candidates generated from RDKit and ordered to match seed element sequence.
value.method_rationale: r2SCAN-3c is a self-contained composite method with dispersion suitable for relative single-point energies of flexible alkanes; gas phase, neutral, singlet, RKS.
limitations: Finite conformer search, not global or free-energy minimum.
Force-field pre-screen is not an ORCA energy.
Force-field convergence is reported per generated candidate; not every candidate was ORCA-evaluated.

observations.name: random_seed

value.note: RDKit ETKDGv3 accepts a fixed randomSeed; the seed is recorded in manifests and observations.

limitations: No non-fixable random component was identified in the executed search.
